The black curve is the true function, the orange circles are the noisy training data, and the cyan curve is the fitted model. For small A (panels a—b), the fitted func- tion passes exactly through the data points. For intermediate A (panels c—d), the function is smoother and more similar to the ground truth. For large A (panels e—f), the regularization term overpowers the likelihood term, so the fitted function is too smooth and the overall fit is worse.
